text: The bug is on line 40: `line.split("=")` splits on every `=`, so `parts[1]` only contains the text up to the second `=`, and then `.split("#")[0]` chops off everything after a `#`. The docstring says the value is everything after the first `=`, with no inline comments. Fix:

arguments.old:
parts = line.split("=")
        if len(parts) < 2:
            raise ValueError(f"line {number}: expected key = value")
        key = parts[0].strip()
        if not key:
            raise ValueError(f"line {number}: empty key")
        result[section][key] = parts[1].split("#")[0].strip()
arguments.new:
parts = line.split("=", 1)
        if len(parts) < 2:
            raise ValueError(f"line {number}: expected key = value")
        key = parts[0].strip()
